anacorp-ana-corp:lever:ce01d4bb-5af3-47f.title: ERP Administrative Technician
anacorp-ana-corp:lever:ce01d4bb-5af3-47f.description: About ANA: Join a recognized industry leader - Alliance North America was proudly named a 2025 Top Workplace in the Manufacturing Industry, an honor based entirely on feedback from our own employees about our culture, values, and workplace experience. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada, with locations in Cypress, California and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling, and we are seeking an ERP Administrative Technician in an onsite position in Spartanburg, South Carolina. As an ERP Administrative Technician, you will work directly with Production and Industrial Engineering to maintain the manufacturing execution system (MES) portion of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and related shop-floor tools. This position is focused on the production-facing portion of the ERP rather than enterprise-wide ERP administration. You will collect, validate, and maintain the workstation data needed to manage the production schedule, support shop-floor management, measure downtime and station-specific KPIs, and accurately close Assembly Orders (AOs) and Production Orders (POs). The position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays from 7:00 AM- 4:00 PM. This role reports to the Plant Manager and receives functional guidance and technical direction from the Industrial Engineer.
responsibilities: Work daily on the production floor to collect, verify, and maintain manufacturing execution system (MES) data from workstations, operators, supervisors, production records, and approved shop-floor data collection tools.

Maintain the production data used to manage the production schedule, including order status, station assignment, work-in-process location, planned versus actual progress, quantities completed, constraints, and completion status.

Support Shop Floor Management data collection by preparing accurate, current station-level information for daily production meetings, hour-by-hour tracking, plan-versus-actual review, work-in-process status, and follow-up actions.

Partner with the Industrial Engineering Technician to collect and validate downtime, cycle time, output, utilization, labor, queue, and other station-specific KPI data using approved definitions and collection methods.

Support the timely and accurate closing of Assembly Orders (AOs) and Production Orders (POs) by confirming required labor, output, component consumption, scrap, rework, serial or lot information, and completion transactions have been recorded and exceptions are resolved.

Review open AOs, POs, workstation records, and production schedule data throughout each shift to identify missing, late, duplicate, or incorrect entries and coordinate corrections before daily reporting or order closure.

Enter approved production information from station logs, paper forms, barcode scanners, tablets, and other source records into Business Central or related MES tools when direct operator entry is unavailable or requires correction.
Reconcile MES transactions against physical work-in-process, completed units, material movement, station status, and supervisor records to confirm the system reflects actual factory activity.

Provide first-line shop-floor support for production transaction questions, order-status issues, barcode or scanner problems, workstation data-entry errors, and incorrect postings; escalate system, hardware, access, or integration issues to the appropriate support team.
Train and coach operators, team leads, and supervisors on approved MES reporting steps, production-data expectations, and the importance of accurate and timely workstation transactions.

Maintain station-level collection tools and controls, including approved work-center and station IDs, transaction guides, production forms, barcode or QR labels, terminals, scanners, and Shop Floor Management tracking aids.

Prepare daily and weekly data-completeness summaries and provide validated source data for production schedule adherence, throughput, downtime, cycle time, labor efficiency, utilization, work-in-process, and other factory metrics.

Support new product, line, and workstation launches by testing AOs, POs, station codes, collection methods, transaction flows, and reporting outputs. Follow approved data-governance and change-control requirements and do not independently change engineering requirements, BOMs, routings, standard times, production priorities, or enterprise-wide ERP configuration
Other duties as assigned
qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or technical certificate in manufacturing, operations, business systems, information systems, or a related field preferred.
Two or more years of experience in manufacturing, production control, production administration, shop-floor data collection, ERP or MES transactions, inventory control, or a related operational role.

Experience working directly in a manufacturing environment and a practical understanding of production schedules, workstations, work-in-process, Assembly Orders, Production Orders, and daily shop-floor activity.
Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is strongly preferred; experience with another manufacturing ERP, MES, or shop-floor data collection system will be considered.
Working knowledge of production-order status, labor reporting, production output, component consumption, scrap, rework, downtime, station movement, and manufacturing order closure.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including sorting, filtering, formulas, lookups, data comparison, and basic data validation.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to compare system records with physical production activity, identify discrepancies, and follow corrections through completion.
Strong communication and coaching skills, with the ability to support operators and supervisors in a respectful, clear, and production-focused manner.
Ability to spend a significant portion of the workday walking and standing on the production floor, using computers, tablets, barcode scanners, and other station-level data collection equipment.

Preferred: experience with barcode systems, Power BI or reporting tools, Shop Floor Management, lean manufacturing, standardized work, daily production scheduling, ISO 9001, or multi-site manufacturing operations.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:83b3aeb5-023b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform based in Netherlands. This is a greenfield SRE leadership opportunity within a large-scale, security-focused product environment. You will define what “healthy” means across roughly 70 components spanning cloud services and customer-hosted agents. You will establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring standards, alerting, and escalation practices from the ground up. Your work will directly improve the ability to detect silent security-control degradation before it becomes a widespread customer-impacting issue. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads and senior engineers while building the telemetry and reliability platform yourself. The environment is remote-first, async, technically demanding, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than dashboards for their own sake. This is an opportunity to shape the reliability culture and foundations of a major security product. Define and establish meaningful SLIs for approximately 70 product components, working with squad leads and senior engineers to agree on ownership, measurement, tiering, SLOs, and error budgets. Develop a reliability taxonomy covering service availability and latency, fleet reachability and configuration convergence, security-control efficacy, artifact delivery, and telemetry pipeline health. Ensure reliability indicators are independently measurable and cannot be disabled by the same failure they are intended to detect. Design and build the telemetry collection pipeline for customer-hosted agents and cloud services, balancing push-based collection, sampling, privacy constraints, data quality, and cardinality. Extend instrumentation across Python, Go, and Rust components in collaboration with product engineering teams. Consolidate existing dashboards, queries, and reporting mechanisms into a smaller, more reliable observability platform, retiring tooling that does not provide meaningful operational value. Implement symptom-based, SLO-driven alerting with multi-window burn-rate principles and clear page, ticket, and dashboard classifications. Ensure every production alert has a defined owner, documented failure mode, and actionable runbook. Establish ongoing alert-quality practices, including periodic reviews, measurable actionable-alert rates, and deliberate removal of unnecessary alerts. wattpad-wattpad:lever:10c4b76d-6fe4-4291.title: [WEBTOON] Marketing Manager
wattpad-wattpad:lever:10c4b76d-6fe4-4291.description: WEBTOON Entertainment is a leading global entertainment company and home to some of the world's largest storytelling platforms. As the global leader and pioneer of the mobile webcomic format, WEBTOON Entertainment has transformed comics and visual storytelling for fans and creators. With its CANVAS UGC platform empowering anyone to become a creator, and a growing roster of superstar WEBTOON Originals creators and series, WEBTOON Entertainment’s passionate fandoms are the new face of pop culture. WEBTOON Entertainment adaptations are available on Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Crunchyroll, and other screens around the world, and the company’s content partners include The Walt Disney Company, HYBE, and DC Comics, among many others. As the Marketing Manager, you will lead the development and execution of strategic marketing initiatives that elevate WEBTOON's brand, drive user acquisition, and boost audience engagements. Collaborating closely with internal teams and external partners, you will manage integrated marketing campaigns, optimizing performance to achieve key business goals. Reporting to the Director of Brand & Partnerships, this high-impact role is a vital part of the Brand & Audience Development team and contributes directly to our marketing flywheel through both B2C and B2B efforts. The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of strategic thinking and executional excellence, with a clear understanding of the value behind diverse partnerships, understanding of the creator economy, and a passion for driving business growth.
responsibilities: Develop brand marketing strategies for WEBTOON across key target audiences, including readers, creators, and prospective creators, to strengthen brand awareness, consideration, and perception.

Ideate, develop, and lead brand-building initiatives and marketing campaigns that elevate the WEBTOON brand, including events, advertising, and strategic partnerships with brands, content partners, creators, and talent.
Own relationships and communications with external content partners, including Disney, Paramount, Blizzard, and other key partners, to drive user growth and success of our shared IPs.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Growth Marketing, Content, Social, PR, Creative, Product, and external stakeholders to create cohesive brand experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.

Lead brand health tracking and consumer research initiatives, proactively leveraging first-party, third-party, and market intelligence data to uncover actionable insights, monitor audience and brand trends, and inform marketing strategy and brand positioning.
Develop scalable marketing frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational processes to improve collaboration, executional excellence, and organizational efficiency.
qualifications: 5+ years of experience in entertainment marketing is required.
Strong understanding of brand marketing , with proven experience developing and executing brand strategies and integrated marketing campaigns.
Deep knowledge of the marketing ecosystem, including advertising, social media, experiential marketing, partnerships, influencer marketing, and content marketing.
Experience marketing to fandom-driven audiences and a strong understanding of fan communities and fan behavior.
Familiarity with WEBTOON, digital storytelling, and the creator economy is strongly preferred.
Proven experience developing and executing creative campaigns in collaboration with internal creative teams and external agencies.
Experience building and managing relationships with external partners; brand partnership or entertainment partnership experience is a strong plus.
Strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to translate consumer insights, market trends, and performance data into actionable marketing strategies.

Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with the ability to independently lead multiple initiatives, manage budgets and timelines, and deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Proven ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority
Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills
Highly adaptable and comfortable navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and a dynamic work environment.
